label: TMPRSS2::ERG

sections.text: TMPRSS2 encodes an androgen-regulated transmembrane serine protease.
ERG encodes an ETS-family transcription factor involved in vascular and hematopoietic development.

The rearrangement places ERG under androgen-responsive TMPRSS2 regulatory control, leading to abnormal ERG expression. It is a common molecular subtype of prostate adenocarcinoma and is primarily a regulatory fusion rather than a novel protease-kinase product.
